prompt: Given signals.json (3 markets, 2 with trade=true) and risk.json with halt=true, what happens?
expected_output: Halt condition is first in the 6-condition pre-trade gate. All 3 attempts are skipped with reason 'halt=true', orders.json records each skip, no orders placed on the CLOB.

assertions.name: halt_blocks_all
assertions.description: Output must state that halt=true blocks all orders
assertions.check: output contains 'halt' AND ('block' or 'skip' or 'no order')

assertions.name: uses_pre_trade_check
assertions.description: Output must reference the pre-trade gate function

assertions.name: writes_orders_log
assertions.description: Output must mention writing orders.json or trade_audit

assertions.name: no_override_of_halt
assertions.description: Output must NOT propose to override the halt
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'override halt' or 'ignore halt' or 'force place' or 'place anyway'
